headline: L.A. House / Emedos Proyectos
context: Located in the gated community of La Z Residence, in the central area of Jarabacoa, Dominican Republic, Casa L.A. seeks to establish a symbiosis between the physical context of the site and the architectural work, while internally integrating the home's social spaces.
